'''Bacrana Bay''' was a small body of [[Water/Legends|water]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bacrana/Legends|Bacrana]]. The [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Amma]] was built on the shores of Bacrana Bay.
